query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date in <year window> AND owner_addr IN ('addr1xxjn7xww4ujjkxwm5wml88ktfsmxcenfec4kde0tltauhaqmry78c25qz570etul7tfu325e968wlq9023kp67kmagxqrumn37')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
